purpose: Human-readable and machine-readable summary of every active Create, Generator, Project Tree and Dependency-Layer target.

trigger_policy.export_intelligence_high: Prompt Builder and USER_PROMPT.txt must introduce all active targets with content-based descriptions and manifest references.
trigger_policy.wrapper_policy: Wrapper is only one target and must not hide backend, frontend, assets, generated or dependency-scoped child targets.
trigger_policy.path_policy: When absolute project paths are enabled, path is compiled absolute and relative_path preserves the project-relative original.

manifest_contract: CREATE_ACTIVE_TARGETS.json is the human target summary for prompts.
CREATE_PROJECT_MAPPING.json remains the target root and tree boundary source.
CREATE_DEPENDENCY_LAYER.json remains the target-scoped package source.
guardrails: Do not collapse active targets to wrapper only.
Do not invent target folders that are not present in config, mapping, generator targets, preview tree or dependency layer.
Do not treat absolute prompt paths as ZIP member names; ZIP entries remain project-relative.
